session.signOutFailed: Sign-out did not complete. Reload the page and try again.
session.unmapped: Your account is not linked to a subject of the learning policy. Ask an administrator to add it to the identity map.
session.unavailable: The studio cannot reach the authoring service. Try again in a moment.

signIn.title: Sign in to the studio
signIn.body: Sign in with your organisation account. The studio never sees your password; your session ends when you sign out or when it expires.

home.title: Studio
home.intro: Create a course, see a course as a whole, and review the proposals that await a person.
home.contextHint: The id of the execution context, as given to the CLI with --context.
home.contextRequired: Enter the id of a context.
home.createIntro: A new course starts empty, in preparation. You become its administrator; nobody else can see it yet.
home.courseHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example prompting-basics.
home.courseRequired: Enter the id of the new course.
home.createForbidden: You may not create courses. Ask an operator to add you to the course template.
home.createConflict: This id is already in use: {{detail}}
home.createInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, at most 64 characters.
home.createFailed: The course could not be created. Try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no studio page at this address.

inbox.title: Review inbox
inbox.approvedEmpty: No approved proposal waits to be applied.

errors.unavailable: This context is not available. Check its id, or ask an operator whether its policy is installed.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to review this context.
errors.failed: The review service did not answer. Try again in a moment.

status.stale: Stale: the context changed before application

proposal.title: Review a proposal
proposal.notFound: There is no proposal {{proposal}} in this context.
proposal.notPending: This proposal does not await a decision. Its status is: {{status}}.
proposal.contentFailed: What this proposal carries could not be read. Reload the page.

changes.heading: Changes against the applied version
changes.intro: Each record of the proposal is compared with the version of the same record that is applied in the context now.
changes.noDifference: No field differs from the applied version.
changes.notApplied: The context has no version of this record yet.

payload.heading: Exact payload
payload.intro: The proposal and its records exactly as the decision will cover them.

decision.heading: Decision
decision.reasonRequired: Write the reason for the decision.
decision.conflict: This proposal changed after you opened it, so your decision was not recorded. The page now shows its current state; review it again.
decision.forbidden: You are not allowed to decide this proposal. Nothing was recorded.
decision.failed: The decision may not have been recorded. The page now shows the current state.

apply.heading: Application
apply.intro: The proposal is approved but not applied. Applying it changes the context; it is a separate step from the approval.
apply.applied: Change applied. The context is now at version {{version}}.
apply.seeCourse: See the result on the course page
apply.conflict: The proposal can no longer be applied as approved: {{detail}} The page now shows its current state.
apply.forbidden: You are not allowed to apply this proposal. Nothing was changed.
apply.failed: The application did not complete. Try again: the retry repeats the same operation, so the change is applied at most once.

teacher.otherProposal: This proposal has no student activity or assessment content. What it changes is listed in the technical details.

changes.heading: What changes
changes.none: The teaching content is the same as the version in use now. Only internal links and versions change; they are listed in the technical details.

change.newActivity: A new student activity is added.
change.newRequirement: A new resource requirement is added: {{value}}
change.purpose: The purpose of a resource requirement changes.
change.material: The text of the material “{{value}}” changes.

students.heading: What students would be asked to do

issues.heading: To check before deciding
issues.none: Nothing to check: no problem was reported.
issues.source: In the course and its source material, not caused by this proposal ({{found}})

issue.generated: “{{name}}” does not fit the course model ({{field}}): {{detail}}
issue.notAllowed: “{{name}}”: the {{field}} “{{value}}” is not one of the allowed values ({{allowed}}).

technical.heading: Technical details
technical.intro: The exact records, their identifiers and a field-by-field comparison, for administrators. The decision covers exactly this payload.

teacher.titleInitialization: Start the authoring project of the course
teacher.titleRelease: Freeze the course as a release
teacher.titleImport: Bring a release into a delivery course
teacher.notAccepted: The review agent did not accept this content. Its assessment (model text): “{{reason}}”. You decide whether to approve it.

project.heading: What this project is
project.intro: Approving creates the authoring project “{{id}}” of this course. It records the exact parts the next steps build on, so that the assessments and the teaching content are prepared from this syllabus and nothing else. Students see nothing new.

release.heading: What this release freezes
release.intro: Approving freezes the course as it is now, so that it can be delivered exactly as reviewed. Nothing reaches students: the delivery, its resources and its permissions come with a later import, reviewed on its own.

delivery.heading: What this delivery brings
delivery.intro_one: Approving brings the frozen release into this delivery course: {{count}} unit, with the activities below. Students get nothing until the course is activated, a separate step.
delivery.intro_other: Approving brings the frozen release into this delivery course: {{count}} units, with the activities below. Students get nothing until the course is activated, a separate step.

completion.heading: When each part counts as completed
completion.intro: Each part of the course gets this rule. It records completion only, never a grade or a verified competence. The teaching content does not change.

syllabus.failed: The syllabus of this proposal could not be read. Reload the page.
syllabus.heading: The syllabus: {{title}}
syllabus.reviewedByAgent: Generated by the Curator and reviewed by the review agent: {{reason}}
syllabus.notAcceptedByAgent: Generated by the Curator, but the review agent accepted none of its drafts: this is the last draft that passed the application's checks. The review agent's assessment (model text): “{{reason}}” You may still approve it, ask for a revision or edit it.
syllabus.editedBy: Edited by {{teacher}}. The review agent has not reviewed this version: you decide it as it is.
syllabus.reasons: Revision requests that led to this syllabus

compare.refinedBy: Compared with the previous proposal “{{title}}”, by {{responsible}}. Units are paired by learning target, in their order.
compare.currentHeading: Compared with the syllabus of the course
compare.current: The course follows the syllabus “{{title}}”. Units are paired by learning target, in their order.
compare.noSyllabus: The course has no syllabus yet: every unit is new.
compare.otherDesign: The course's current design was not built as a syllabus: every unit is new compared with it.
compare.titleChanged: The title of the syllabus changes.
compare.orderChanged: The order of the units changes.

revision.heading: Revision by the Curator
revision.intro: The Curator receives this syllabus and the reasons of every revision request that led to it. Its new syllabus is a new proposal, which you review and decide.
revision.ask: Ask the Curator for a revised syllabus

edit.heading: Edit the syllabus
edit.intro: Your version becomes a new proposal by you, compared with this one. It is checked like a syllabus from the Curator; the review agent does not review it. You can then approve and apply it.
edit.title: Title of the syllabus
edit.claimHint: One sentence that the chosen excerpts state.
edit.citationsRequired: Each unit cites at least one excerpt, with what it supports.
edit.checks: The syllabus must still cover every learning target of the model, and each unit cites the prepared or retrieved sources only.

course.title: Course
course.notVisible: The course content of this context is not visible to you.
course.review_one: Review inbox: {{count}} proposal awaits a decision
course.review_other: Review inbox: {{count}} proposals await a decision

structure.heading: Structure
structure.intro: Phases and units in their order, with the activities of each.
structure.empty: The learning design has no structure yet.

history.heading: History
history.intro: Every proposal made for this course, newest first, with its decisions and its application.

course.notStarted: This course has no syllabus yet.
course.build: Build the course from an AIM-PRO model
course.continueBuild: Continue building the course: initialize the project, or replace the syllabus

build.title: Build the course
build.intro: Start the course from an AIM-PRO model: upload it, prepare its sources if you want, let the Curator draft a syllabus, review it, then initialize the project.
build.replaces: This course already has a syllabus. Steps 1 to 3 draft a new one: once it is approved and applied, it replaces the current syllabus, which stays in the course history. A course has one syllabus at a time.
build.notKept: This page does not keep an upload after you leave it: upload the file again, it is recognized and not stored twice. Jobs go on without the page: find them in the list of jobs below, or the proposals in the review inbox.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this in this course.
errors.failed: The request did not complete. Try again.

jobs.heading: Jobs of this course
jobs.intro: The agent jobs started for this course, newest first. The list is read when the page opens; reload it to see changes.
jobs.failed: The list of jobs could not be read. Reload it.

upload.heading: 1. Upload the AIM-PRO model
upload.intro: The file is checked and kept exactly as you send it; it is never edited.
upload.fileHint: The JSON file exported from jjodel (megamodel format 1.0).
upload.scenarioHint: The name of the scenario model in the export, as jjodel shows it (for example SCN01). If the name is wrong, the refusal lists the models in the file.
upload.scenarioRequired: Enter the name of the scenario.
upload.competenciesHint: The name of the competency model in the same export (for example elena_usecase_competencies).
upload.competenciesRequired: Enter the name of the competency catalogue.
upload.stored: The model was accepted and stored unchanged.
upload.conforms: The scenario fits the course model.
upload.notConforms: The scenario does not fully fit the course model. You can still continue: the problems below go with the syllabus to its review.
upload.contractIssues: Does not fit the course model ({{found}})

sources.heading: 2. Prepare the sources (optional)
sources.intro: Choose the sources the Curator works from. Search the sources of the course, pick the excerpts and say what each one is for, then review the prepared sources. They are not used until you accept them. You can also skip this step and give the Curator a search query in step 3.
sources.queriesHint: One query per line, at most 20, all different.
sources.queriesRequired: Enter between 1 and 20 different queries, one per line.
sources.kHint: How many excerpts each query may find, from 1 to 20.
sources.queued: Waiting for the agent worker… If this does not change, the worker is not running.
sources.awaiting: The sources are prepared and wait for your choice.
sources.accepted: Accepted. The Curator can work from these sources in step 3.
sources.declined: Declined. These sources will not be used. You can search again or pick other excerpts.
sources.retry: Nothing was recorded for the course. You can try again.
sources.pickIntro: The search found {{count}} excerpts. Tick those the Curator should use, and say what each one is for and what it does not cover.
sources.licenceNote: A licence is not an approval: you decide whether each excerpt may be used in this course.
sources.nothingFound: Nothing was found. Search again with other queries.
sources.usage: Usage conditions: licence {{licence}}; the corpus verdict on it is “{{verdict}}”.
sources.usageNoVerdict: Usage conditions: licence {{licence}}; the corpus has no verdict on it, check it before use.
sources.purposeHint: What the Curator should take from this excerpt.
sources.purposeRequired: Say what this excerpt is for.
sources.limitationsHint: One limitation per line, for example the audience it was written for.
sources.needsUpload: Upload the model in step 1 first: the prepared sources are tied to it.
sources.reviewIntro: {{count}} excerpts from the source scope {{scope}}, fetched exactly as they were found. Accept them to let the Curator use them, or decline them.

coverage.heading: Coverage requirements (optional)
coverage.intro: Ask the syllabus to cover an exact passage of the model: choose a learning target, the target or one of its practices, a text field, and copy an exact part of its text. The Curator must then plan a unit that does what you write.
coverage.needsUpload: Upload the model in step 1 to add coverage requirements.
coverage.load: Show the targets of the model
coverage.quoteHint: Copy an exact part of the text shown above.
coverage.actionHint: The action the syllabus must plan, in a few words.
coverage.incomplete: Complete every part of this requirement.
coverage.quoteMismatch: The passage is not an exact part of the chosen text.

curator.heading: 3. Draft the syllabus with the Curator
curator.intro: The Curator reads the uploaded model and either the sources you accepted in step 2 or the sources found for a search query, and proposes a syllabus. Nothing changes until you approve it.
curator.needsUpload: Upload a model first, in step 1. After leaving this page, upload the file again: it is recognized and not stored twice.
curator.scopeHint: The collection of sources this course may search, as named in its policy.
curator.queryHint: What the sources should be about, in a few words.
curator.queued: Waiting for the agent worker… If this does not change, the worker is not running.
curator.running: The Curator is drafting the syllabus… With a large model this takes several minutes. You can leave this page: the proposal will appear in the review inbox.
curator.retry: Nothing was changed. You can ask the Curator again.
curator.proposed: The syllabus is ready and waits for your review.
curator.abandoned: The job was abandoned by an administrator.
curator.ended: The Curator did not propose a syllabus: {{detail}}
curator.preparedHint: The model, scenario and source scope are the ones the sources were prepared for.

project.heading: 4. Initialize the project
project.intro: Once the syllabus is applied, the project gathers what the next steps build on: assessments, materials and the release.
project.label: Project id
project.hint: A short name for the project, for example main.
project.proposed: The project is proposed and waits for your review.
project.next: Next, the steps below: the assessments, the teacher and trainer content, and the completion rules.

reviews.summary: How the review agent judged the Curator's drafts
reviews.intro: The review agent checks each draft of the Curator against the course model and the cited excerpts. A draft it does not accept goes back to the Curator, at most three drafts per job. Its assessments are its own words: model text, not a decision of the application or of a person.
reviews.failed: The assessments could not be read.
reviews.none: No draft of this job reached the checks or the review agent.
reviews.final: The assembled draft of every block: {{outcome}}
reviews.reused: Block {{block}}: accepted in an earlier job over the same inputs, used again without a new draft

outcome.rejected: not accepted by the review agent
outcome.uncertain: the review agent was uncertain, so it was not accepted
outcome.checks: refused by the application's checks before the review agent saw it
outcome.timedOut: its model call reached the time limit before the draft was complete
outcome.truncated: the model's response was cut at its length limit before the draft was complete

reviews.flags: Fits the course model and its sources: {{alignment}}. Citations support the claims: {{citations}}.
reviews.generationFlags: Fits the approved syllabus and its sources: {{alignment}}. Citations support the claims: {{citations}}. Right intent (explain, practice or assess): {{intent}}. Content complete: {{complete}}.

generation.summary: How the review agent judged the drafts of this job
generation.intro: The generator writes the assessments, teacher or trainer content in blocks of up to 12 units. The review agent checks each draft of a block against the approved syllabus and the cited excerpts; a draft it does not accept goes back to the generator, at most three drafts per block. It then judges the draft assembled from every block once. Its assessments are its own words: model text, not a decision of the application or of a person.

generators.failed: The project could not be read.
generators.needsAssessments: Apply the assessments of step 5 first: this content builds on them.
generators.requirementsHint: One per line, for example “Explain two prompting choices.” They are passed to the agent as they are.
generators.stale: The course has changed since this form was read. It has been read again: check what it sends and queue the job again.
generators.staleContent: Some content was made from an earlier version of what it depends on ({{targets}}). Generate it again before proposing the completion rules.
generators.queued: Waiting for the agent worker… If this does not change, the worker is not running.
generators.running: The agent is working… With a large model this takes several minutes. You can leave this page: the proposal will appear in the review inbox.
generators.proposed: The proposal is ready and waits for your review.
generators.abandoned: The job was abandoned by an administrator.
generators.ended: No proposal was made: {{detail}} Nothing was changed; you can queue the job again.

evaluator.heading: {{step}}. Assessments with the Evaluator
evaluator.intro: The Evaluator proposes the assessments and rubrics of the syllabus units. Nothing changes until you approve and apply them.

teacher.heading: {{step}}. Teacher content
teacher.intro: The Teacher proposes the explanations, examples and other material of the units that explain, built on the applied assessments.

trainer.heading: {{step}}. Trainer content
trainer.intro: The Trainer proposes the practice material of the units that practise, built on the applied assessments.

completion.heading: 8. Completion rules
completion.intro: Every part of the course gets one rule: it is complete when every part directly inside it is complete. The rule records completion only, never a grade or a verified competence. The generated content does not change.
completion.needsTrainer: Apply the trainer content of step 7 first.
completion.needsFresh: Generate the content listed above again first: the rules are proposed on a project whose content is up to date.
completion.proposed: The completion rules are proposed and wait for your review.
